masterBacklogAdditions.title: Proposal surge velocity
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Track proposal-count growth between hourly sweeps, not only the current bucket. A role moving to 50+ proposals within its first hours should be aggressively down-ranked even when fresh.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Economic floor by work type
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Maintain separate minimum effective-pay thresholds for TPP, part-time, local brigades and freelance work so low-value local hits are rejected consistently before manual review.

policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
